title: OWASP WrongSecrets
description: OWASP's app of badly stored secrets: dozens of challenges on finding secrets hardcoded in code, front-end JavaScript, container images and environment, configuration files, logs, Git history and compiled binaries. This is the Docker variant; the Kubernetes, Vault and cloud challenges are not available.
question: Find the secrets of the WrongSecrets challenges; each secret entered on its challenge page gives a code to submit.
